mentions.name: Estimatle
mentions.description: A daily estimation game where players answer five questions per day that require estimating quantities such as distance, year, or cost. After answering, players can compare their guesses against other players' answers and the real answer. The question mix is being tuned to balance fun with helping players learn facts about the world.
mentions.problem: Finding the right balance of estimation questions that are both fun and help players understand facts about the world.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A daily estimation game: https://estimatle.com

Every day, players answer 5 questions that require estimating some quantity, such as distance, year, cost etc. Then you can compare against answers of other players and the real answer.
